_about: Hand corrections for pipeline/tools/spell-rules.py, per spell label. Any field of the sheet (stops, cover, dodge, windup, answer) wins over the derived one. 'check' says why a zone is not judged by the walk-out rule: 'sure' (a sure hit or a mark: its answer is sight or nothing, not stepping out), 'placement' (the zone only places a wall, a unit or the caster: nothing is hit when it lands), 'spacing' (a quick melee swing: the answer is to stand out of reach before it, not to react), 'lingering' (it hurts while you stand in it: leaving is the answer, there is no landing). A spell with no 'check' is judged.

polarity.answer: stay 4 m or more from her rods

thunder rod.answer: leave the 3.5 m slowing field round the rod

issen.answer: step off the line: it shows 0.45 s before he crosses it

noto.answer: step out of his 3.5 m ring while it shows (0.5 s); do not hit him just after the click

senbon.answer: walk out of the 3 m ring before the first wave (1 s)

sekai giri.answer: leave the line during the still second (1.3 s); carry few cut marks into it
